name: Algorithmiq
description: Algorithmiq develops quantum algorithms for life sciences and drug discovery applications. The company focuses on creating quantum-enhanced computational methods for molecular simulations and pharmaceutical research. Originally founded in Helsinki and backed by Finnish quantum research, Algorithmiq relocated its global headquarters to Milan, Italy in May 2026 following an EUR 18M funding round — Italy's largest quantum VC investment to date.

news.title: Algorithmiq relocates global HQ from Helsinki to Milan and raises EUR 18M — Italy's largest quantum VC round
news.excerpt: Algorithmiq established Milan as its global headquarters following an EUR 18M round led by United Ventures and CDP Venture Capital, Italy's largest-ever quantum startup investment. The company retains operations in Finland and brings total funding to EUR 36M. The move follows Italy's National Quantum Strategy launched in 2025.
